title: Replace HTS core leaves (hts_get_bgzfp, hts_get_format, hts_itr_destroy, hts_idx_destroy, hts_set_fai_filename, hts_getline, cram_seek) with pure Rust
description: Replace 7 HTS core FFI leaf functions: hts_get_bgzfp (6 lines, accessor), hts_get_format (3 lines, accessor), hts_itr_destroy (13 lines, cleanup), hts_idx_destroy (26 lines, cleanup), hts_set_fai_filename (15 lines, string store), hts_getline (30 lines, line reader), cram_seek (7 lines, seek). All are leaves. Used across multiple modules. Complexity: trivial-easy.
